entries.title: Simply connected twisted E₆ order and fixed projection
entries.parameter_domain: For the group order and fixed projection: finite fields F and K, [Field F], [Field K], [Finite F], [Finite K], [Algebra F K], Module.finrank F K = 2, and q=|F|>=2. The separate weighted Weyl-sum identity holds for every natural number q, without field hypotheses.
proved_scope: The actual simply connected graph–Frobenius fixed subgroup H has order q^36(q^12−1)(q^9+1)(q^8−1)(q^6−1)(q^5+1)(q^2−1), including q=2. The actual weighted Bruhat Weyl sum is evaluated.
The actual fixed projection onto the adjoint fixed subgroup is surjective. Quotienting H by that projection kernel gives the adjoint fixed subgroup.
unproved_conclusions: The kernel is not asserted to be the entire center. Full center, order of the quotient by the full center, and simplicity remain open; no completed twisted-E₆ simple-family entry follows.

entries.title: Quadratic-field matrix and minuscule centralizer recovery
entries.parameter_domain: Finite fields F,K with [Field F], [Field K], [Finite F], [Finite K], [Algebra F K] and Module.finrank F K = 2, including |F|=2. Matrix recovery allows every finite decidable index type n and arbitrary matrices g,A,B; its hypothesis quantifies over every u in K. Minuscule recovery uses any Strings I Ω with finite decidable Ω, any i,j:I, nonzero integers ε,δ, any matrix g, and commutation with every ordered quadratic-conjugate root product. No invertibility of g or commutation of the two steps is assumed.
proved_scope: For arbitrary finite matrices, commutation with every quadratic-conjugate affine pair recovers commutation with both component matrices.
For the existing marked minuscule root matrices, commutation with every twisted paired root product recovers commutation with both individual root families.
unproved_conclusions: These are matrix/blockwise conclusions, not a full fixed-group center theorem. Faithfulness of a minuscule projection and an affine formula for the quadratic adjoint block are not claimed.

entries.title: Large Ree ²F₄ full order and generation
entries.parameter_domain: Let F be any finite field of characteristic 2, let m be a natural number (m ≥ 0), and assume hcard: |F| = 2^(2m+1). Write q = |F| and G = Atlas.ReeF4.Model F m. No positivity assumption on m is imposed. Perfectness alone additionally requires 1 ≤ m. The named binary order theorem fixes m = 0 and assumes |F| = 2.
proved_scope: For q = 2^(2m+1), the actual intrinsic large Ree model has order q^12(q^6+1)(q^4−1)(q^3+1)(q−1) and is generated by the specified actual root, torus and Weyl operators. These conclusions include q = 2, whose full group order is 35,942,400. The full model is perfect for m ≥ 1 (q ≥ 8).
unproved_conclusions: Simplicity, field transport and the remaining incidence geometry are open.
Perfectness requires m>=1; no perfectness of the full binary group is claimed. No binary-derived index, order, simplicity or identification with the retained Tits model follows.

entries.title: Large Ree ²F₄ parabolics and binary action
entries.parameter_domain: Let F be any finite field of characteristic 2, let m be a natural number (m ≥ 0), and assume hcard: |F| = 2^(2m+1). Write q = |F| and G = Atlas.ReeF4.Model F m. No positivity assumption on m is imposed. All parabolic, tail and full line-kernel statements include m = 0. The faithfulness and permutation-kernel endpoints fix F = ZMod 2, m = 0; the separate cardinality endpoints at q = 2 allow any finite field of order two.
proved_scope: The full first-point stabilizer is explicitly the image of R ⋊ (Sz(q) × Fˣ), with |R| = q^10 and |P| = q^12(q²+1)(q−1)². The full marked-line stabilizer is explicitly the image of K ⋊ GL₂(F), where the full pointwise kernel K lies in U, has eleven-field-parameter coordinates, is solvable, and has order q^11; |Q| = q^12(q−1)²(q+1). Both equivalences multiply the normal factor first and include q = 2. Over ZMod 2, the full model and its literal commutator subgroup act faithfully on the actual 1,755-point set.
unproved_conclusions: The eleven-parameter kernel coordinate equivalence is a bijection of types, not an assertion that the kernel is an additive vector group.
Explicit radical filtrations, maximal normal 2-subgroup recognition, Borel/intersection and residue identifications, and full generalized-octagon geometry remain open.

Faithfulness endpoints use the literal field ZMod 2; separate transport of this action to every two-element presentation is not asserted. Faithfulness does not establish derived index/order, transitivity, perfectness, simplicity or a Tits identification.

entries.title: J₁ local subgroup and the 1,596-point orbit
entries.parameter_domain: The fixed original octonion construction over ZMod 11 with its retained generators P,Q,R,S, subgroup H=<P,Q,R>, seven-dimensional trace-zero projective space and ten specified seed points.
proved_scope: The actual sign subgroup has order 8 and the P,Q subgroup has order 21. The unique sign–P–Q normal form gives |H|=168.
The ten disjoint H-orbits have sizes 84,168,...,168. Their 1,596-point union is invariant under the actual generated group, equals its orbit of the marked point, and carries a transitive action.
unproved_conclusions: The full point stabilizer, full-action faithfulness/primitivity, sextic geometry, full J₁ order and simplicity remain open. The number 1,596 is an orbit cardinality, not the group order.

entries.title: Binary G₂ derived subgroup and split extension
entries.parameter_domain: Derived-subgroup statements: arbitrary F with [Field F], [Finite F] and |F|=2. The sign-kernel and split-extension statements fix F=ZMod 2; they are not asserted for every presentation by a new transport theorem.
proved_scope: The literal binary derived subgroup is the long-root normal closure, has order 6,048 and index 2, and is perfect and nonabelian simple. In the fixed binary presentation it is the kernel of the actual line-sign map.

The short-root involution supplies the actual complement C={1,rootF(1)}. Its sign map identifies C with the sign group; multiplication gives the internal semidirect equivalence H ⋊ C ≃ G with the inherited conjugation action.
unproved_conclusions: No equivalence to PSU₃(3), matching of the outside action with the F₉/F₃ involution, or full-group extension comparison is supplied.

proved_scope: The 28 marked line transvections generate the actual special unitary group and their images generate the full-center projective quotient.

The projective unitary group and binary long-root subgroup have separately faithful numbered 28-point actions. The actual octonion words and the independent PSU order 6,048 specialization are retained.
unproved_conclusions: The two numberings and equal orders do not identify or conjugate the two permutation images. Actual generator matching, an isomorphism and the full outside-action comparison remain open. The Final6048 namespace on the order lemma does not make it a final bridge.
